executiveSummary: The paid-search review removed a keyword conflict and documented a substantial Ad Rank constraint for further review. Organic reporting carried forward the Fairfield pages and schema work completed in August. The September 11 client call is now scheduled, with lead quality, connected calls and accepted forms as the main measurement priorities. The current Google Ads window recorded only five impressions, so the report keeps delivery volume and business outcomes distinct.

work.title: August Fairfield work reviewed
work.detail: The contributor’s August summary reported six Fairfield service-area pages and schema updates across ten pages, including FAQ sections on later pages. These are August deliverables discussed on September 1, not newly built September pages.
work.whyItMatters: Provides the organic baseline for the next local-search review.
work.periodNote: Prior-period work: completed in August, discussed September 1.

work.title: Conflicting broad negative removed
work.detail: The broad negative keyword free was removed from the active campaign because it conflicted with the free-estimate offer. The negative list moved from fifteen to fourteen entries and was reloaded to verify the change.
work.whyItMatters: Removes a specific eligibility conflict for searches seeking a free estimate.

work.title: Ad Rank constraint investigated
work.detail: The diagnostic review found 74.07% Search impression share lost to rank across the inspected eighteen-keyword view. The $2 maximum CPC limit was identified as a candidate constraint, not a proven cause. The $7 daily budget and bid settings were unchanged.
work.whyItMatters: Defines a focused follow-up without claiming a bid increase has already solved delivery.

work.title: Client call confirmed for September 11
work.detail: An updated calendar invitation confirmed the Onsite and Momentum call for Friday September 11, 12:00 to 12:30 Eastern, with the client address and Momentum attendees on the invite.
work.whyItMatters: Fixes a date for the updates and next-steps conversation that had been slipping since August 31.

work.title: Lead quality and profile upkeep prioritized
work.detail: The account check-in named Google Business Profile management and Google Ads lead quality as the immediate priorities. The review will distinguish connected calls and accepted forms from clicks.
work.whyItMatters: Directs the client conversation toward the enquiries the business can act on.

decisions.decision: Client call set for September 11, 12:00 to 12:30 Eastern.

nextSteps.title: Continue the Fairfield page buildout
nextSteps.detail: Stated next priorities are continuing additional Fairfield pages, with ongoing schema and internal linking as new pages go live.

nextSteps.title: Validate connected calls and accepted forms
nextSteps.detail: Carried forward from the August report: validate connected calls and accepted form submissions rather than raw click volume.

nextSteps.title: Run the September 11 client call
nextSteps.detail: Cover updates and next steps with the client, including lead quality from Google Ads.

nextSteps.title: Review the rank constraint with fresh evidence
nextSteps.detail: Recheck delivery after the negative removal and assess the bidding constraint without assuming its cause.

caveats: The six Fairfield pages and ten-page schema update are contributor-reported August work, not a new September build.
Conversion reporting is pending validation. The current platform snapshot is not a verified count of qualified enquiries.
The rank-loss diagnostic is a separate dated view from the September 1 to 8 performance totals.
Google Ads includes September 8 only through the displayed collection time. The current day is partial and platform reporting is not real time.
